title: Steel sparks off tusk cut in pillars of rainbow alloy muzzle wrapped blade frozen in teeth of quantum law eye to eye spirits drawn hop amongst a parla
summary: Steel sparks off tusk cut in pillars of rainbow alloy muzzle wrapped blade frozen in teeth of quantum law eye to eye spirits drawn hop amongst a parlay painting a mosaic of magic and form #smallpoems
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Steel sparks
off tusk
cut in
pillars of
rainbow alloy

muzzle wrapped
blade frozen
in teeth of
quantum law

eye to eye
spirits drawn

hop amongst a parlay
painting a
mosaic of magic and
form
#smallpoems
